tools.name: find_traders
tools.description: Polymarket traders, filtered and sorted like the page; head lines say what applied and what the defaults hid. copyable: % of checked trades a follower could fill (n=checked); ret_lo: ROIC, profit per copy as % of stake, past window, 80% low end (n=copy10_n); 4★+ needs a 90% low end above 0: copy10_l

tools.name: get_trader
tools.description: One trader: a row per category, rule check, radar with n, stars history, 5 newest trades. <=3 KB.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Rows per category at each stars level, plus the page's chip counts. <=800 B.

tools.name: explain_rating
tools.description: The 1-5★ rule; with trader, that trader's check per level, radar and stars history. <=1.5 KB.

tools.name: get_copy_recipe
tools.description: One trader's copy recipe for your own agent (/traders/<slug>/copy.md): watch, rules, costs, YAML; format=json: copy.json. Not advice. <=5 KB.

tools.name: get_bot_guide
tools.description: How to build a copy bot and steer it with find_traders' filters (/bots.md). Not advice.

tools.name: get_scorecard
tools.description: Do 3★+ traders' signals, copied at $10, beat matched 2★ ones? The pre-registered forward test (/api/v1/scorecard); ready false until powered. <=1.5 KB.

tools.name: watch_traders
tools.description: /api/v1/watch: the traders you copy, one call: stop_copy and stop_why per row, warnings, book_* stats, list changes since a cursor. TSV <=4 KB; json: the API body.

tools.name: get_rating_changes
tools.description: /api/v1/changes: list adds, drops and re-rates after a cursor. TSV <=4 KB; json: the API body.

tools.name: get_recent_signals
tools.description: /api/v1/feed: leader trades with gate and fill status; no since: the newest. TSV <=4 KB; json: the API body.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_recent_signals · Public sink: get_scorecard · Destructive: get_copy_recipe.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_recent_signals · Public sink: get_scorecard · Destructive: get_copy_recipe

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
